signature.name: VTask.ConvolutionExistsAt
signature.type: {M : Type u_1} -> {S : Type u_2} -> {E : Type u_3} -> {E' : Type u_4} -> {F : Type u_6} -> [Monoid M] -> [CommSemiring S] -> [AddCommMonoid E] -> [AddCommMonoid E'] -> [AddCommMonoid F] -> [Module S E] -> [Module S E'] -> [Module S F] -> [TopologicalSpace F] -> (L : E →ₗ[S] E' →ₗ[S] F) -> (f : M → E) -> (g : M → E') -> (x : M) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.ConvolutionExistsAt is a Prop-valued summability predicate with no junk-value conventions; it is simply false when the fiber sum is not summable, and no special boundary assignments are made.

facts.statement: ∀ {M : Type*} {S : Type*} {E : Type*} {E' : Type*} {F : Type*} [Monoid M] [CommSemiring S] [AddCommMonoid E] [AddCommMonoid E'] [AddCommMonoid F] [Module S E] [Module S E'] [Module S F] [TopologicalSpace F] (L : E →ₗ[S] E' →ₗ[S] F) (f : M → E) (g : M → E') (x : M), (VTask.ConvolutionExistsAt L f g x) = Summable (fun p : {ab : M × M | ab.1 * ab.2 = x} => L (f p.1.1) (g p.1.2))

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {M : Type*} {S : Type*} {E : Type*} {E' : Type*} {F : Type*} [Monoid M] [CommSemiring S] [AddCommMonoid E] [AddCommMonoid E'] [AddCommMonoid F] [Module S E] [Module S E'] [Module S F] [TopologicalSpace F] (L : E →ₗ[S] E' →ₗ[S] F) (f : M → E) (g : M → E') (x : M), ¬ VTask.ConvolutionExistsAt L f g x → ¬ Summable (fun p : {ab : M × M | ab.1 * ab.2 = x} => L (f p.1.1) (g p.1.2))

facts.statement: ¬ VTask.ConvolutionExistsAt (LinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) 0

facts.instance: VTask.ConvolutionExistsAt (LinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) 0
facts.violated_property: summability of the fiber sum: the fiber over 0 in (ℕ, +) is the singleton {(0,0)}, but more generally constant functions on an infinite fiber yield a non-summable family
